channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Perplexity and Intelligence
item.description: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki argues for perplexity as a shared cross-lab metric for comparing models and setting safety standards, citing internal measurements of about 0.99 for GPT-3.5 and 0.91 for GPT-4. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Team is already preparing another big update, but how are things since yesterday’s update to the ChatGPT/Codex desktop app? What still requires attention and is not quite there? https://t.co/1X8M5JwL77
item.description: The ChatGPT/Codex desktop app's update has the team already preparing another major release, while this post asks which issues still need attention and invites readers to follow the latest progress and join the discussion. (Follow Builders · X · Thibault Sottiaux)

item.title: mjmirza/app-store-compliance — Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 124 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 112 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.
item.description: An open playbook documents 124 App Store and Google Play rejection patterns with fixes, tracks 112 regulatory deadlines including the EU AI Act, DSA and COPPA, and adds pre-submission privacy manifest and Data safety checks that let AI coding agents catch risks before upload. (GitHub Trending)

item.title: Show HN: I built a game where you play as a subagent of a large language model (LLM)
item.description: On worker755.com, real LLMs such as Claude and GPT act as your manager, issuing terminal commands under a 90-second countdown, then checking results, filing incident reports, and writing your performance review. (github.com)

item.title: By 2028, 87% of Anthropic's power will come from natural gas and 11% from coal
item.description: Anthropic’s 2028 power mix could be 87% natural gas and 11% coal, with mid-case emissions of 32 million metric tons of CO2 and no direct U.S. renewable-energy commitment. (betterdatacenterproject.com)

item.title: A Beginner's Guide to Local AI with Inkling, Qwen, and Unsloth
item.description: Setting up a free, private ChatGPT-style local AI takes beginners 10 to 15 minutes on Windows with Unsloth, running a 4-bit Qwen3.8-27B on an RTX 5090 with 128K context and LAN sharing, no terminal or subscription needed.

item.title: The myth of "conscious AI
item.description: Anil Seth argues in "The Mythology of Conscious AI" that consciousness is more likely a property of life than of computation, and that building conscious or even conscious-seeming AI is a bad idea. (www.noemamag.com)

item.title: Harvard CS 2881R AI Safety
item.description: Harvard CS 2881R, taught by Boaz Barak, requires in-person attendance at 13 lectures in Fall 2026, sets Homework Zero's deadline for August 5, 2026, and discloses his OpenAI conflict of interest.

item.title: Muru – AI-assisted Rust server for Python apps by mod_WSGI's creator
item.description: Graham Dumpleton, who started mod_wsgi 20 years ago, built Muru, an AI-assisted Rust server for ASGI and WSGI Python apps, with three weeks of detailed public logs on what still falls short.
